name: search_work_objects
description: Search the work-object store by keyword (over titles + step contents) to find prior or ongoing work — e.g. 'washer dryer research'. Returns matching work objects (id, title, status), newest first. Read-only; follow with read_work_object to read one in full.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Keywords to match (all terms must appear in the work object's title or step contents).

outputs.description: results: list of {work_id, title, status, updated_at}.
